blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2–41.4% for prior work.
Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/
blocks.zh:
ML论文中的管线数字必须重新用于多幅画布,包括纸柱,16:9幻灯片,肖像海报,1:1社交取笑者,9:16手机预览. 每种格式都对同一种计算图规定了不同的一面比,其中任何默不作声地断开的连接都会歪曲方法. 我们制定了一个独特的任务: 光栅流图和目标比, 产生一个结构上忠实的,无幻觉的,可编辑的布局。 现有方法在特征上失败:图像到图像模型会伸展出块并拒绝极端比例,文本到图像代理系统会产生幻觉内容,以及解析到当时的系统会错向边缘. 我们提出一个代理管道 包含到Parse, Style, 和布局阶段, 每个管道将一个主要代理和一个评论员配对, 将决定性的制约检查和VLM视觉反馈结合起来, 从而明确检查连接 并防止被无声地打破。 输出为raw.io-editable mxGraph XML. 根据双子座3.1 Pro 评估的、经人类判断验证的100个流程图的总基准,我们的方法在先前的作品中达到了68.6%的内容Fidelity,相对于11.2-41.4 %。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Three categorical failure modes on flowchart relayout. Given input (a) at 1:1 and a request for 3:2, we examine three families. (b) Image-to-image models (e.g., Nano Banana Pro) resize in pixel space, stretching embedded frames and blocks, and they also reject aspect ratios outside 3:1–1:3. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pipeline figures are central to how vision and ML research is communicated, yet the same diagram has to live across many canvases: paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each target imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, and every conversion must preserve the original blocks, edges, and flow direction. Any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. Manually re-laying out figures for each canvas is tedious and error-prone. As shown in Fig. 1 , our goal is to produce structure-preserving relayouts at arbitrary aspect ratios from a single source figure, with each output remaining editable in draw.io for further refinement.

blocks.en: Recent work on automating scientific-figure creation falls into three families. Image-to-image (I2I) models such as Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2.0 re-synthesize the source figure at a requested resolution. Text-to-image agentic systems, PaperBanana ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) , SciFig ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , and Paper2Poster ( Pang et al., 2025 ) , orchestrate planner, stylist, and critic agents to create a new figure from a methodology description. A third line targets editability: AutoFigure-Edit ( Lin et al., 2026 ) emits SVG, while AutomaTikZ ( Belouadi et al., 2023 ) and DeTikZify ( Belouadi et al., 2024 ) use TikZ. All target figure generation from textual or programmatic inputs; none takes an existing flowchart and refits it to an arbitrary canvas while keeping its computational graph intact.

blocks.en: When repurposed for relayout, each family exhibits a categorical failure mode (Fig. 2 ). I2I models resize in pixel space. Embedded panels and blocks are uniformly stretched, and ratios outside 3:1–1:3 are rejected. T2I agentic systems re-synthesize from a prompt, dropping source blocks and adding labels not present in the source. Parse-then-render systems recover the components but mis-route edges, breaking the directed graph that the flowchart exists to communicate. None simultaneously achieves the three properties this task requires: structural fidelity, hallucination-freedom, and arbitrary canvas resizing in a downstream-editable format. As summarized in Table 1 , these methods produce non-editable raster outputs, lack native flowchart-editor support, or cannot resize an existing flowchart to arbitrary canvases.

blocks.en: We introduce an agentic pipeline for aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout. Given a raster flowchart F 0 F_{0} and target ratio r r , our method produces a draw.io-compatible mxGraph XML X ∗ X^{*} that preserves the structure, content, and style of F 0 F_{0} while fitting the new canvas. Since directly resolving structure, appearance, and spatial arrangement in a single step is difficult, we decompose the problem into three stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic (Fig. 3 ). The Parse stage recovers structured XML from F 0 F_{0} with SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) spatial priors; the Style stage reconstructs visual appearance while extracting colors deterministically to mitigate unreliable VLM color perception; and the Layout stage rearranges the recovered graph for the target canvas, combining deterministic structural checks with VLM visual feedback to prevent connectivity errors. We further curate flowcharts from oral papers at top-tier venues, evaluate them at five target ratios, and propose four VLM-as-a-Judge metrics validated against human judgments. Our pipeline reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2–41.4% for prior work.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task and propose the first agentic pipeline for it, factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each guarded by a critic combining VLM reasoning with deterministic verification so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. • We construct FlowchartRelayoutBench , a benchmark pairing flowcharts from CVPR/ICCV/ECCV/NeurIPS/ICLR/ICML oral papers at five target ratios (9:16, 2:3, 1:1, 3:2, 16:9) with a four-metric VLM-as-a-Judge protocol (Relationship Preservation, Hallucination-free Rate, Layout Quality, Style Similarity) validated against human assessments. • Experiments and a user study show that our pipeline substantially outperforms both monolithic VLM and existing agentic figure systems on the structural-fidelity dimensions that matter most for cross-canvas relayout.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Scientific figure generation has evolved from one-shot synthesis ( Rodriguez et al., 2023 ; Belouadi et al., 2023 ; Belouadi et al., 2024 ) to planner–critic agents for charts ( Dibia, 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Goswami et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2023 ) , slides ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , posters ( Pang et al., 2025 ) , diagrams ( Zala et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) , pipeline and architecture figures ( Zhu et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Guo et al., 2026b ) , and layouts ( Lin et al., 2023a ; Guo et al., 2026a ) , with dedicated benchmarks ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent systems improve editability through structure–style–layout decomposition ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , PowerPoint or SVG outputs ( Shao et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and programmatic checks ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . We similarly use multi-agent decomposition, but refit an existing raster flowchart to a target canvas while preserving structure and style.

blocks.en: Structured synthesis targets vector graphics ( Carlier et al., 2020 ; Reddy et al., 2021 ; Rodriguez et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , TikZ ( Belouadi et al., 2023 ; Belouadi et al., 2024 ; Belouadi et al., 2025 ) , and draw.io XML ( Yu & Jiang, 2026 ) . Raster structure recovery includes parse-then-re-render methods ( Savva et al., 2011 ; Poco & Heer, 2017 ) , document/diagram understanding ( Kembhavi et al., 2016 ; Lee et al., 2023a ; Huang et al., 2022 ; Hong et al., 2024 ) , image-to-code benchmarks ( Roberts et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , and flowchart-specific methods ( Schäfer & Stuckenschmidt, 2019 ; Sun et al., 2022 ; Shukla et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Singh et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Dou et al., 2026 ) . Closest to our Parse stage, concurrent work converts rasters to editable mxGraph XML ( Cui et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2026 ; Sivertsen et al., 2026 ) , SVG ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , or Mermaid ( Deka & Devereux, 2025 ) , some supporting instruction-driven edits ( Su et al., 2026 ; Sivertsen et al., 2026 ) . Beyond conversion, we re-lay out the recovered graph for any target aspect ratio while preserving its relationships.

blocks.en: Classical graph drawing includes Sugiyama layering ( Sugiyama et al., 1981 ; Gansner et al., 1993 ) , Graphviz ( Gansner & North, 2000 ) , ELK ( Domrös et al., 2023 ) , constraint-based routing ( Dwyer et al., 2008 ; Wybrow et al., 2009 ) , and aspect-ratio-aware heuristics ( Nachmanson et al., 2007 ) , and underpins learned layouts based on transformers ( Lee et al., 2020 ; Gupta et al., 2021 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) , diffusion ( Inoue et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Levi et al., 2023 ; Iwai et al., 2024 ) , LLMs ( Feng et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2023b ; Tang et al., 2023 ) , and content-aware objectives ( Hsu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Horita et al., 2024 ) . Related retargeting adapts images ( Avidan & Shamir, 2023 ; Rubinstein et al., 2010 ) or visualizations to different displays ( Hoffswell et al., 2020 ; Kim et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2020 ; Kim et al., 2021 ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . These methods do not explicitly preserve directed-graph connectivity under arbitrary canvas changes. Our Layout stage combines hierarchical drawing with VLM feedback and deterministic checks for edge preservation and overlap.

blocks.en: LLM-as-judge ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) extends to vision ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Lee et al., 2024 ; Xiong et al., 2025 ) , including diagram ( Liang & You, 2025 ) and video assessment ( Huang et al., 2026c ) ; visual generation benchmarks include ( Lee et al., 2023b ; Ku et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Agentic systems for figures ( Dibia, 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Pang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) and data generation ( Huang et al., 2026a ) also use VLM judges, despite positional and perceptual biases ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Yasunaga et al., 2025 ) and memorization ( Szu-Tu et al., 2025 ) . Critic-based self-refinement ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) can be unreliable without external signals ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , motivating execution-grounded critiques ( Chen et al., 2024b ) . We thus pair VLM reasoning with deterministic edge-preservation, overlap, and canvas-containment checks.

blocks.en: 3.1 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架概览

blocks.en: Given an input raster flowchart F 0 F_{0} and a target aspect ratio r = ( W , H ) r=(W,H) , our method produces a draw.io-compatible mxGraph XML file X ∗ X^{*} that preserves the structure, content, and style of F 0 F_{0} while fitting the target canvas: X ∗ = ℱ ⁡ ( F 0 , r ) . X^{*}=\mathcal{F}(F_{0},\,r). (1) Since instance identity, visual appearance, and spatial arrangement are tightly coupled, direct end-to-end parametrization is ill-posed. Therefore, we decompose the transformation into three sequential stages, each handled by a main agent paired with a Critic Agent that iterates until convergence. In the Parse Stage , F 0 F_{0} is converted into a structured mxGraph XML X X encoding every block, edge, and group. In the Style Stage , X X is refined into a styled XML X ^ \hat{X} whose visual properties reflect those of F 0 F_{0} . In the Layout Stage , X ^ \hat{X} is rearranged into the target canvas r r , producing X ∗ X^{*} with all inter-block relationships preserved. blocks.en: 3.2 Parse Stage
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 解析阶段

blocks.en: The Parse Stage converts the input raster flowchart F 0 F_{0} into structured mxGraph XML X X encoding blocks, connectors, groups, and embedded visual assets. To reduce VLM spatial perception errors, the Parse Agent uses SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) to obtain instance-level bounding boxes, category priors, and spatial attributes as structured geometry context, while embedded images and icons are stored as cropped assets with XML placeholders for reinjection after the Layout Stage. After each iteration, the Critic Agent compares F 0 F_{0} , X X , and its draw.io-rendered PNG to verify connector logic, structural consistency, and visual correspondence, returning correction instructions until the result passes or the iteration limit is reached (Fig. 4 ; Appendix G.1 and G.2 ).
blocks.zh: 剖析阶段将输入光栅流图F 0 F_{0}转换为结构化的mxGraph XML X编码块,连接器,组和嵌入式视觉资产. 为了减少VLM空间感知错误,解析剂使用SAM 3(Carion等,2025年)来获得实例级边框,类前缀,以及空间属性作为结构几何上下文,而嵌入式图像和图标则被作为被裁剪的资产被存储在XML占位符中,以在布局阶段后进行再喷出. 每次重复后,批评代理比较了F 0 F_{0},X X,及其平分. io-resisted PNG用于验证连接器逻辑,结构一致性,以及视觉通信,在结果通过或重复限制达到之前返回更正指令(图4;附录G.1和G.2).

blocks.en: 3.3 Style Stage
blocks.zh: 3.3 样式阶段

blocks.en: The Style Stage refines X X into styled XML X ^ \hat{X} that matches the visual appearance of F 0 F_{0} while preserving its recovered structure and semantics. To reduce VLM color perception errors, a PIL-based Color Extraction Tool extracts per-block color assignments from F 0 F_{0} using block positions recorded in the XML; the Style Agent then updates fill and stroke colors, text style, and arrow style while keeping block text, edge source/target references, and group membership immutable. After each iteration, the Critic Agent compares F 0 F_{0} , the rendering of X ^ \hat{X} , and the extracted color assignments to verify visual correspondence, returning correction instructions until the result passes or the iteration limit is reached (Fig. 4 ; Appendix G.3 and G.4 ).
blocks.zh: 样式阶段将 X X 精炼成与 F 0 F_{0} 的视觉外观相匹配的有风格的 XML X ^\ hat{X},同时保留其恢复的结构和语义. 为了减少VLM色彩感知错误,一个基于PIL的"彩色提取工具"利用XML所记录的块位置从F0F_{0}中提取出每个块的色彩任务;然后"样式代理"更新了填充和中和颜色,文本样式,并箭头样式,同时保留块文本,边缘源/目标引用,以及组成员不可变. 每次重复后,批评代理比较了F 0 F_{0},渲染出X ^\hat{X},并提取出色彩任务来验证视觉通信,返回更正指令直到结果通过或重复限制达到(图4;附录G.3和G.4).

blocks.en: 3.4 Layout Stage
blocks.zh: 3.4布局阶段

blocks.en: The Layout Stage rearranges X ^ \hat{X} onto the target canvas r = ( W , H ) r=(W,H) to produce X ∗ X^{*} while preserving inter-block relationships. The Layout Agent extracts edge relationships from the XML and performs directed-graph-based hierarchical relayout, first within containers and then across containers, preserving connectivity and keeping related blocks spatially close. After each iteration, the Critic Agent combines deterministic checks for overlap avoidance, relationship preservation, and canvas containment with visual comparison of the draw.io-rendered PNG and F 0 F_{0} to identify routing, spacing, or arrangement issues, returning correction instructions until the layout passes or the iteration limit is reached (Fig. 4 ; Appendix G.5 , G.6 , and G.7 ).

blocks.zh: 3.5 样式传输

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We introduce FlowchartRelayoutBench , a benchmark pairing 100 source flowcharts at five target ratios with a four-metric VLM-as-a-Judge protocol under hierarchical scoring.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Flowchart Relayout Bench, 以5个目标比率对100个源流图的基准配对,并在分级评分下采用4个计量的VLM-as-a-Judge协议.

blocks.en:
The dataset comprises 100 flowcharts from oral-level and above papers at top-tier AI/CV venues over the past three years: ECCV (30), CVPR (30), NeurIPS (12), ICLR (10), ICCV (9), and ICML (9). To cover heterogeneous source-diagram structures, we deliberately curate examples spanning three
predefined structural-complexity levels: 25 easy, 40 medium, and 35 hard flowcharts. The benchmark contains 15.5 nodes and 13.6 edges per figure on average, with both quantities generally increasing with structural complexity. Detailed definitions, statistics, and performance breakdowns for the three levels are provided in Appendix A .
Each source is evaluated at five baseline-supported aspect ratios (9:16, 2:3, 1:1, 3:2, 16:9), yielding 500 relayout tasks.
blocks.zh:
数据集包括过去3年中顶级AI/CV地点的100个口服及以上论文流程图:ECCV(30)、CVPR(30)、NeurIPS(12)、ICLR(10)、ICCV(9)和ICML(9)。 为了涵盖不同的源图表结构,我们有意整理三个实例。
预定义的结构-复杂级别:25个易取,40个中取,和35个硬流图. 基准中包含15.5个节点和13.6个边/个平均数字,两者的数量一般随着结构的复杂性而增加. 附录A提供了三个职等的详细定义、统计和业绩细目。
每个来源按五个基线支持的方面比率(9:16,2:3,1:1,3:2,16:9)进行评估,产生500个中继任务.

blocks.en: We adopt a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol for reference-based evaluation. For each sample, the judge model compares the relayout result against the original flowchart under the target canvas size, and assesses whether the candidate preserves the original structure, content, layout adaptation, and visual style (Appendix H.1 , H.2 , H.3 , and H.4 ). We independently validate agreement between these VLM judgments and human assessments in Sec. 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过了以参考为基础的评估的《作为法官的自愿程序手册》。 对于每个样本,评委模型将中继出结果与目标画布尺寸下的原始流程图进行比较,并评估候选人是否保留了原始结构,内容,布局适应,以及视觉风格(附录H.1.,H.2.,H.3.和H.4.). 我们独立地验证了这些自愿终止措施判决与人类评估在4.4节中达成的协议。

blocks.en: Inspired by PaperBanana’s evaluation protocol ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) , we evaluate relayout results from two perspectives: Content Fidelity and Visual Quality .
blocks.zh: 我们受Paper Banana评估协议(Zhu等,2026a)的启发,从两个角度评价中继结果: 内容Fidelity和视觉质量.

blocks.en: • Content Fidelity. Content Fidelity has two binary checks. Relationship Preservation verifies that connector logic (source, target, and flow direction) matches the original. Hallucination-free Rate checks that no elements are added or omitted. Each is pass/fail; the score is the pass ratio. • Visual Quality. Visual Quality contains two ranking-based metrics. Layout Quality ranks valid candidates by canvas utilization and overall arrangement, while penalizing trivial scaling, stretching, or simply rotating a landscape layout to fit a portrait canvas. Style Similarity ranks by preservation of original block colors, text styles, and connector styles. The judge jointly ranks all methods per sample; we report the average rank (lower is better).
blocks.zh: • 内容Fidelity。 内容Fidelity有两个二进制检查. 关系保存验证连接器逻辑(源,目标,和流向)与原相匹配. 无幻觉 速率检查中未添加或省略元素 。 每分为通过/失败;得分为通过比. • 视觉质量。 Visual Quality包含两个以排名为基础的衡量标准. 布局质量通过布局利用和总体安排对有效候选人进行排名,同时惩罚微不足道的缩放,伸展,或者简单地旋转地貌布局来适应肖像布局. 样式相似性通过保存原始块颜色,文本样式,和连接器样式来排列. 法官对每个样本的所有方法进行联合排名;我们报告平均等级(较低者更好)。

blocks.en: Hierarchical scoring prioritizes content correctness over visual quality. Candidates are first ranked by the number of passed Content Fidelity checks, with two passes ranked above one pass and one pass above none. Ties are then ordered by the combined Layout Quality and Style Similarity. Finally, rank k k among N N candidates is mapped to ( N − k ) / ( N − 1 ) × 100 (N-k)/(N-1)\times 100 .
blocks.zh: 分级评分将内容正确性置于视觉质量之上. 考生按通过内容Fidelity检查的次数排名第一,有2个考生的成绩在1个考生以上,1个考生的成绩在0个考生以上. 然后由组合布局质量和样式相近性来定型. 最后,在NN候选人中,Kk的排名被绘制为(N-克)/(N- 1)×100(N-克)/(N-1)\times 100。

blocks.en: We compare against four baselines in three categories. Image-to-image : Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2.0 directly generate raster output from the source. T2I agentic : PaperBanana ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) , adapted via text descriptions of each source. Parse-then-render : AutoFigure-Edit ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , with its VLM settings adapted to target the requested ratio (it does not natively support resizing). All baselines are conditioned on the target ratio and source.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.2 比较

blocks.en: Table 2 reports quantitative comparisons against all baselines. Our method achieves the best Relationship Preservation (74.2%), Hallucination-free Rate (90.6%), Content Fidelity (68.6%), and Overall score (81.85), showing stronger structural and content preservation. Qualitative comparisons are shown in Fig. 6 . For more visual results, please refer to Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 表2报告与所有基线的定量比较。 我们的方法实现了最佳关系保全(74.2%)、无幻觉率(90.6%)、内容Fidelity(68.6%)和总体分数(81.85),显示出更强的结构和内容保全。 图6显示了定性比较。 更多视觉结果请参见附录F。

blocks.en: I2I models often preserve relationships through padding or stretching, but can still distort or hallucinate elements. AutoFigure-Edit performs worse because its SVG lacks explicit source and target connectivity, while PaperBanana is further affected by hallucination and relationship mismatches from text-driven regeneration.
blocks.zh: I2I模型经常通过粘接或拉伸来保留关系,但仍能扭曲或幻觉元素. AutoFigure-Edit的性能更差,因为其SVG缺乏明确的源和目标连接,而Paper Banana则受到由文本驱动再生产生的幻觉和关系错配的进一步影响.

blocks.en: I2I models rank better in Style Similarity by largely preserving the original pixels, while our XML reconstruction introduces a modest style gap. PaperBanana ranks best in Layout Quality because its text-driven generation does not preserve the original block geometry or exact connectivity, allowing freer visual arrangement.
blocks.zh: I2I模型在Style相近性中排名更好,主要保存了原始像素,而我们的XML重建则引入了适度的风格间隙. Paper Banana在"布局质量"中排名最好,因为其由文本驱动的生成无法保留原来的块几何或精确的连接,允许更自由的视觉安排.

blocks.en: Our method achieves the highest Overall score (81.85), reflecting a better balance between content correctness and visual quality. Baselines with strong visual appearance score lower when content or connectivity is not preserved.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法实现了最高的总分(81.85分),反映了内容正确性和视觉质量之间更好的平衡. 当内容或连通性得不到保存时,具有强烈视觉外观的基线得分较低.

blocks.en: 4.3 User Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 用户研究

blocks.en: We conduct a user study on 50 cases, each with one source flowchart and five candidate relayouts (ours and four baselines), yielding 250 outputs in total. Each participant evaluates 4 randomly assigned cases, providing binary judgments on Relationship Preservation and Hallucination-free Rate, and ranking candidates 1st–5th for Layout Quality and Style Similarity. Participants are recruited from CS backgrounds, many with CV/ML expertise; detailed criteria reduce inter-annotator variability.
blocks.zh: 我们对50个案例进行用户研究,每个案例有1个源流程图和5个候选中继图(我们的和4个基线),共产生250个产出。 每个参与者对4起随机分配的案件进行评价,对关系保护和无幻觉率作出二进制判断,对布局质量和样式相似性排名第1-5名。 参与者来自CS背景,许多人具有CV/ML的专业知识;详细标准减少了通知人之间的可变性.

blocks.en: We collect 600 image-level evaluations from 30 participants (Fig. 7 ). Our method performs best on Relationship Preservation, Hallucination-free Rate, and Layout Quality, while I2I baselines remain stronger in Style Similarity. Despite their near-verbatim appearance preservation, users still find our editable XML reconstruction visually competitive.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了30名参与者的600个图像级评价(图7)。 我们的方法在关系保存、无幻觉率和布局质量方面表现最佳,而I2I基线在Style相似性方面仍然更强。 用户仍然发现我们可编辑的 XML 重建在视觉上具有竞争力。

Our method achieves the best performance on Relationship Preservation and Hallucination-free Rate, and shows strong pairwise win rates in Layout Quality and Style Similarity.

blocks.en: We conduct quantitative ablations on a complexity-balanced subset of 30 flowcharts, with 10 easy, 10 medium, and 10 hard examples. We examine: (1) multi-stage decomposition versus direct prompting, (2) the contributions of the Style Stage and Critic Agents, and (3) replacing our Layout Stage with a conventional graph-layout algorithm. All variants use the same 30 flowcharts and evaluation protocol. Visual comparisons are provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en: Replacing the Parse or Layout Stage with direct prompting reduces Content Fidelity from 76.7% to 33.3% and 66.7%, respectively, while one-shot VLM-to-XML generation drops it to 33.3% with Gemini 3.1 Pro and 30.0% with GPT-5.5. The full pipeline also achieves the best Layout and Style ranks, showing that task-specific decomposition improves both structural fidelity and visual quality beyond the underlying VLM alone.
blocks.zh: 以直接提示取代剖析或布局阶段将内容Fidelity分别从76.7%降至33.3%和66.7%,而一发VLM到XML的生成则将其降低到33.3%,双子座3.1 Pro和30.0%的GPT-5.5. 整个管线还实现了最好的布局和样式排行,表明任务特定的分解在结构忠心和视觉质量上都超越了仅基本的VLM.

blocks.en: Removing all Critic Agents reduces Content Fidelity from 76.7% to 46.7% and Overall from 87.04 to 61.85. Removing either the Parse or Layout Critic also degrades Content Fidelity, while removing the Style Stage mainly worsens Style Similarity and lowers Overall to 76.30. These results confirm the complementary roles of stage-specific critics in correcting structural and layout errors and of the Style Stage in preserving appearance.
blocks.zh: 取消所有批评机构,将内容Fidelity从76.7%降至46.7%,总体从87.04降至61.85。 删除“解析”或“布局批评”也会降低“内容”的清晰度,而删除“样式阶段”主要会使“样式”的相似性恶化,总体降至76.30。 这些结果证实了针对阶段的批评者在纠正结构和布局错误方面的互补作用,以及样式阶段在维护外观方面的互补作用。

blocks.en: Replacing our Layout Stage with Graphviz DOT reduces the Overall score. Its topology-driven layout lacks explicit target-canvas awareness, often leaving substantial unused space, and fails to preserve relationships involving container structures.
blocks.zh: 用 Graphviz DOT 取代我们的布局阶段降低了总分。 其由地貌学驱动的布局缺乏明确的目标扫描意识,往往留下大量未使用的空间,未能保留涉及集装箱结构的关系.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en:
We present an agentic pipeline for aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout, refitting a raster flowchart to an arbitrary target canvas while preserving structure, content, and visual style in a draw.io-editable output. The pipeline decomposes the problem into three stages: Parse, Style, and Layout. Each stage is guarded by a Critic Agent that pairs deterministic verification with VLM reasoning, so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Experiments on FlowchartRelayoutBench and a user study confirm substantial gains over image-generation and agentic figure-generation baselines, particularly on structural and Content Fidelity.
Limitations are discussed in Appendix B .

将光栅流图重新配置到任意的目标画布, 同时保留结构、内容和视觉风格, 管道将问题分解为三个阶段:剖析、样式和布局。 每个阶段都由一位批评者代理守卫,将确定性核查与VLM推理配对,因此连接被明确检查并被防止被无声破坏. 关于Flowchart Relayout Bench的实验和一项用户研究证实,特别是在结构和内容Fidelity方面,图像生成和代理数字生成基线取得了巨大进展。

blocks.en: Appendix B Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录B 限制

blocks.en: Our XML-based reconstruction framework prioritizes editability over exact pixel preservation, which introduces an inherent visual style gap relative to methods that directly manipulate original image pixels. Although the generated diagrams remain structurally faithful and fully editable, subtle discrepancies in typography, icon rendering, spacing, or low-level visual appearance may still occur. Closing this gap while preserving editable graph structure remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们基于XML的重建框架将可编辑性优先于精确的像素保存,这引入了相对于直接操纵原始图像像素的方法的内在视觉风格差距. 虽然所生成的图在结构上仍然忠实,完全可以编辑,但在打字,图标渲染,间隔,或低等视觉外观上仍然可能出现微妙的差异. 缩小这一差距同时保留可编辑的图表结构,仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: Our main experiments rely on Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, a proprietary multimodal model, which introduces limitations in reproducibility, accessibility, deployment cost, and privacy-sensitive usage scenarios. Future model updates outside our control may also affect output behavior. In Appendix D , we replace Gemini with the open-weight Qwen3.6-27B model. The proposed pipeline continues to outperform direct generation under the same VLM, but its substantially lower absolute structural fidelity shows that current performance remains sensitive to the capability of the underlying model.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要实验依赖于双子座 3.1 Pro Preview,一种专有的多模式模型,它引入了对可复制性,可访问性,部署成本和对隐私敏感的使用方案的限制. 未来模式更新在我们控制之外,也可能影响输出行为. 在附录D中,我们将双子座取而代之的是开放式的Qwen3.6-27B型. 拟议的管道在同一个甚高频下继续超过直接生成,但其绝对结构忠诚度低得多表明,目前的性能对基本模型的能力仍然敏感。

blocks.en: The proposed critic-guided refinement mechanism is heuristic rather than formally guaranteed. Each stage terminates after either receiving a passing judgment or reaching a fixed maximum number of iterations. Although the deterministic validators substantially reduce structural failures, the overall iterative process does not guarantee convergence or globally optimal layouts. In rare cases, outputs may still contain subtle visual artifacts or aesthetically suboptimal arrangements that are not detected by the VLM critic.
blocks.zh: 建议的批评者指导完善机制是热情的,而不是正式保证的。 每一阶段在接到通过的判决或达到固定的重复次数后终止。 虽然确定性验证器大大减少了结构故障,但整体迭接过程并不能保证趋同或全球最佳布局. 在罕见的情况下,出品可能仍会包含微妙的视觉文物或美学上不理想的安排,而VLM评论家并没有发现.

blocks.en: Our deterministic checker verifies the integrity of source–target connectivity relationships but does not explicitly optimize edge-routing aesthetics. As a result, diagrams with high node density, complex graph topology, or extreme aspect-ratio transformations may still exhibit unnecessary edge crossings, uneven spacing, or visually unnatural routing despite preserving correct connectivity.
blocks.zh: 我们的确定性检查器验证了源 - 目标连接关系的完整性,但没有明确优化边缘路线美学。 因此,具有高节点密度、复杂地图地形或极端侧面-纬度变化的图表尽管保持了正确的连接,但仍可能显示不必要的边缘交叉、不均衡的间隔或视觉上不自然的路由。

blocks.en: The multi-stage agentic pipeline introduces substantially higher inference cost and latency than direct one-shot generation methods. Each relayout instance requires approximately 10–20 VLM API calls across the three stages, in addition to one SAM 3 inference pass. Runtime is dominated by remote API latency rather than local computation. While this overhead is manageable for individual editing tasks, reproducing the full benchmark evaluation may require sustained API throughput and incur non-trivial monetary cost under current commercial API pricing.

blocks.en: To test whether our pipeline generalizes beyond Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, we replace the underlying VLM with the open-weight Qwen3.6-27B while keeping the Parse–Style–Layout pipeline unchanged, and compare against direct XML generation using Qwen3.6-27B and direct image editing using Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. As shown in Table 7 , despite the lower absolute performance of Qwen3.6-27B, our pipeline outperforms direct XML generation with the same VLM, reducing XML-format failures from 16.0% to 0.0% and improving Content Fidelity from 0.0% to 20.0%. Direct image editing often retains the original elongated layout with limited structural rearrangement while introducing visible artifacts and inconsistencies in text and diagram blocks, as illustrated in Fig. 13 . These results indicate that the pipeline transfers across model families, although absolute performance remains dependent on the underlying VLM.

blocks.en: Appendix E Style Transfer
blocks.zh: 附录 E 样式传输

blocks.en: This appendix details the optional reference-guided Style Transfer extension introduced in Section 3.5 . Given a completed relayout output X ∗ X^{*} and an unrelated reference image R R , the extension transfers the visual style of R R to produce a restyled XML X R ∗ X^{*}_{R} without altering structural or semantic content. Because R R and X ∗ X^{*} have no spatial correspondence, a Color Extraction Tool first quantizes colors in LAB space to obtain separate fill and stroke palettes from R R , after which a VLM assigns each palette entry to semantic roles such as background, primary fill, text, and connector color. A Style Agent then iteratively rewrites the style attributes of X ∗ X^{*} under Critic Agent feedback, while inferring non-color properties including corner roundness, font family, and arrow style directly from R R . A qualitative example is shown in Fig. 14 .
blocks.zh: 本附录详细介绍了第3.5.节中引入的可选参考指南样式转移扩展. 鉴于已完成的中继输出 X * * * * * 和不相干的参考图像 R R ,扩展会转移 R R 的视觉风格,以产生被重排的 XML X R * * * * R } 而不会改变结构或语义内容. 由于R R和X *QQ没有空间对应,一个"彩色提取工具"首先将LAB空间中的颜色进行定量,从R 中获取单独的填充和中风调色板,之后一个VLM将每个调色板条目指定为语义角色,如背景,主填充,文本和连接器颜色. 一个样式代理然后在 Critic Agent 反馈下迭代地重写 X * 的样式属性,同时从 R R 直接推断出非颜色属性,包括角圆度,字体家族和箭头样式. 图14显示了一个定性实例。

blocks.en: Figure 14: Style transfer results. Colors are transferred via semantic role assignment (background, primary fill, connector) rather than pixel matching, since (a) and R R share no spatial correspondence.
